attchmntText: Innovana Thinklabs Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication
voiceSummary: Innova Thinklabs Limited filed a notice regarding the publication of newspaper advertisements containing extracts of its unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and half-year ended September 30, 2026. The advertisements were published on November 15, 2026. The financial results were reviewed by the Audit Committee and approved by the Board of Directors during meetings held on November 14, 2026. The full format of the financial results is available on the websites of BSE Limited, National Stock Exchange of India Limited, and the company's website. The intimation is submitted in accordance with Regulation 33 read with Regulation 47(1) of the SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015. The Chairman and Managing Director is Chandan Garg, with DIN 06422150.

attchmntText: Innovana Thinklabs Limited has informed the Exchange about statement of deviation(s) or variation(s) under Reg. 32
desc: Statement of deviation(s) or variation(s) under Reg. 32
voiceSummary: Innovana Thinklabs Limited confirms no deviation or variation in the use of proceeds from the preferential allotment of 8,60,000 warrants. The warrants were issued at Rs. 431 each. The company raised a minimum of Rs. 9,26,65,000 on September 5, 2025. An additional Rs. 5,17,20,000 was received on October 13, 2025, upon the conversion of 1,60,000 warrants. Total proceeds received as of December 31, 2025, stood at Rs. 14,43,85,000. The funds are allocated for general corporate purposes. The Audit Committee reviewed the utilization for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, and observed no deviations from the stated objects. The statement was approved by the Audit Committee on November 14, 2026. The remaining amount of Rs. 22,62,75,000 is expected to be received within 18 months from the date of allotment.

attchmntText: Innovana Thinklabs Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Innovana Thinklabs Limited approved its unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and half-year ended September 30, 2026. The Board took note of the limited review report issued by M/s Goyal Darda & Co. For the quarter ended September 30, 2026, revenue from operations was Rs. 4,460.65 lacs, and net profit was Rs. 657.76 lacs. Earnings per share stood at Rs. 3.18. For the half-year ended September 30, 2026, revenue from operations was Rs. 8,357.67 lacs, and net profit was Rs. 1,211.45 lacs. Earnings per share were Rs. 5.86. Total assets as at September 30, 2026, amounted to Rs. 39,751.67 lacs. The trading window for directors and designated persons opens 48 hours after the declaration of these results.
